x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change agenda-publish-and-invite-members (REQ-APIM-002, matrix rows age-05 and pla-05). Publishing the agenda sends the convocation. PublicationEligibilityService and the Publication widget read convocationSentAt before a public meeting's agenda may go public, but no schema declared it, so OpenRegister stored nothing and the check could never pass.

convocationSentAt.title: Convocation sent at
convocationSentAt.description: When the members were first invited, by publishing the agenda.
convocationSentAt.x-notes: Set by AgendaService::publishAgenda() on the first publication and kept on a republish.
